The company exhibits a strong profitability profile with a 24% operating margin and a solid gross margin of 51%. Its sizable asset base of over $40 billion and adequate liquidity (current ratio of 1.18) provide stability, though the moderate leverage (total liabilities comprising about 65% of total assets) constraints the rating from the highest investment-grade tiers. Overall, this financial standing is characteristic of a mid-to-lower investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB+
